## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes introduced in this PR and why they are needed.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`ruff check .` passes).
- [ ] I have added automated tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pytest tests/ backend/`).
- [ ] I have verified that no API keys, tokens, or personal secrets are committed.
- [ ] My changes do not break existing working video rendering pipelines.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly if applicable.
